_comment: Copy to config.json and update the device names, addresses, and tuning for this machine.
_steamMachineName: Optional Steam client name. Set this when more than one signed-in PC is available.
_tvIp: Optional TV address. A DHCP reservation is recommended. Without it, volume ducking is disabled and launches cannot verify the TV's power state.
_sentryDsn: Optional Sentry DSN for errors, traces, and check-ins. Log shipping uses the collector's separate configuration.

media._enabled: Enable after configuring the services, media roots, quality profiles, and API keys.
media._protonPortSync: Keep qBittorrent's listening port in sync with the active Proton VPN port.
media._healthSync: Poll Radarr and Sonarr for health issues, failed imports, and stalled downloads.
media._diskWatch: Monitor free space for the media root and checkout. SMART monitoring is configured separately.

textInterface._enabled: Authenticated HTTP chat. Set textInterfaceToken first. Use 127.0.0.1 for local access or 0.0.0.0 for LAN access.

remoteInterface._enabled: MCP server for remote assistant access. Enable textInterface and set remoteInterfaceToken first. Keep the host on 127.0.0.1 behind the tunnel.

voice._wakeTuning: wakeNearMissFactor controls near-miss logging. wakeClipsKeep limits saved wake clips; 0 disables them.
voice._wakeGates: wakeVadThreshold filters non-speech audio. wakePatience requires consecutive matching frames and adds about 80 ms per extra frame. Both default to 0.
voice._wakeVerifier: Optional speaker-specific verifier model from src/slopstation/agent/models. Enabling it replaces the base score, so retune wakeThreshold. wakeVerifierThreshold controls when verification runs.
voice._duckSteps: Soundbar volume steps removed during a voice session and restored afterward. Requires tvIp. Set to 0 to disable.
voice._duckToPct: Reduce volume to this percentage during a voice session. Values 1-99 override duckSteps; 0 disables it.
voice._holdWindowS: Seconds the mic stays open after an answer with nothing said. 8 is about a Google Home's follow-up window.
voice._eagerEot: Eager end-of-turn settings are currently unused because Pipecat delivers the signal as an interim frame.
voice._navTargets: Map each accepted spoken phrase to a navigation target. The target slot uses exact matches.
